title: Bisacodyl Use in the Post-operative Care of Obstetrical/Gynecological (OB/GYN) Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether Bisacodyl, 5 mg usage decreases the incidence of nausea and abdominal pain after surgery, and also decreases the number of hospitalization days.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Obstetrical and gynecological patients undergoing abdominal surgery.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects undergoing a bowel resection.
* Subjects who have a nasogastric tube for bowel decompression.
* Subjects allergic to Bisacodyl.
* Subjects with mechanical bowel obstruction undergoing bowel resection.
